title: Switches and Lamps
statementMd:
You are given $*n*$ switches and $*m*$ lamps. The $*i*$-th switch turns on some subset of the lamps. This information is given as the matrix $*a*$ consisting of $*n*$ rows and $*m*$ columns where $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = 1$ if the $*i*$-th switch turns on the $*j*$-th lamp and $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = 0$ if the $*i*$-th switch is not connected to the $*j*$-th lamp.

Initially all $*m*$ lamps are turned off.

Switches change state only from "off" to "on". It means that if you press two or more switches connected to the same lamp then the lamp will be turned on after any of this switches is pressed and will remain its state even if any switch connected to this lamp is pressed afterwards.

It is guaranteed that if you push all $*n*$ switches then **all $*m*$ lamps will be turned on**.

Your think that you have too many switches and you would like to ignore one of them.

Your task is to say if there exists such a switch that if you will ignore (not use) it but press all the other $*n* - 1$ switches then all the $*m*$ lamps will be turned on.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 2000$) — the number of the switches and the number of the lamps.

The following $*n*$ lines contain $*m*$ characters each. The character $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$ is equal to '`1`' if the $*i*$-th switch turns on the $*j*$-th lamp and '`0`' otherwise.

It is guaranteed that if you press all $*n*$ switches **all $*m*$ lamps will be turned on**.

## Output

Print "`YES`" if there is a switch that if you will ignore it and press all the other $*n* - 1$ switches then all $*m*$ lamps will be turned on. Print "`NO`" if there is no such switch.
statementZhMd:
给定 $*n*$ 个开关和 $*m*$ 盏灯。第 $*i*$ 个开关可以打开某些灯。相关信息由一个具有 $*n*$ 行、$*m*$ 列的矩阵 $*a*$ 给出：如果第 $*i*$ 个开关可以打开第 $*j*$ 盏灯，则 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = 1$；如果第 $*i*$ 个开关未连接到第 $*j*$ 盏灯，则 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = 0$。

初始时，所有 $*m*$ 盏灯均处于关闭状态。

开关的状态只会从“关闭”变为“打开”。这意味着，如果按下两个或更多连接到同一盏灯的开关，那么在其中任意一个开关被按下后，这盏灯就会打开；即使之后再次按下连接到这盏灯的任意开关，它也会保持打开状态。

保证如果按下全部 $*n*$ 个开关，**所有 $*m*$ 盏灯都会打开**。

你认为开关太多了，希望忽略其中一个开关。

请判断是否存在这样一个开关：忽略（不使用）它，并按下其余 $*n* - 1$ 个开关后，所有 $*m*$ 盏灯都会打开。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 2000$），分别表示开关的数量和灯的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个字符。字符 $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$ 在第 $*i*$ 个开关可以打开第 $*j*$ 盏灯时等于 '`1`'，否则等于 '`0`'。

保证按下全部 $*n*$ 个开关后，**所有 $*m*$ 盏灯都会打开**。

## 输出格式

如果存在一个开关，忽略它并按下其余 $*n* - 1$ 个开关后所有 $*m*$ 盏灯都会打开，则输出 "`YES`"。如果不存在这样的开关，则输出 "`NO`"。
